mcqs.explanation: Every NEB rule has a scope (e.g. a specific range, temperature, or sign convention); stating the condition earns full marks.

examShortTricks: Trick 1: Allergy = exaggerated IgE response to harmless antigens (pollen, dust); chemicals histamine and serotonin cause sneezing, watery eyes, rashes — name the chemicals.
Trick 2: Treatment: antihistamines (cetrizine), adrenaline for anaphylaxis — the two drugs to quote.
Trick 3: Autoimmunity: immune system attacks SELF (memory loss of self-tolerance) — rheumatoid arthritis, type-1 diabetes, lupus; quote two.
Trick 4: Hereditary angle: allergies run in families (atopy) — the genetic susceptibility line.
